what: Ada signs one header listing her seq 1 twice, a case and a note, each row naming it. A list that repeats a seq in any tables is not a list, so the header is not authentic: merging A into B refuses it as BATCH_SIGNATURE_INVALID in Ada's name and takes neither row, and the rows, naming a header refused already, are not reported again. A reader taking both rows spends one seq on two rows (the step 6 review).
